errors.text_span: стълбът за месец III за 2024 година е най-висок
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for month III of 2024 is the highest in the chart. Visually, the bar for month XII of 2022 is the highest.
The bar for month III of 2024 reaches a value of approximately 124,000, not 130,000 as stated. The highest bar in the chart (month XII, 2022) is also below 130,000 (around 127,000).

errors.text_span: докато стълбовете за месец VI за 2023 година са сред най-ниските
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar for month VI of 2023 as one of the lowest. Its value is approximately 98,000, which is not among the lowest values in the chart. The lowest values are around 82,000 (e.g., for months VII, VIII, and XII of 2023).

The value for the bar for month VI of 2023 is approximately 98,000, not 75,000. Additionally, the lowest value in the entire chart is around 82,000, so 75,000 is an incorrect value for any data point.
